programme.desc: Thirty years after the events of the 1984 All Valley Karate Tournament, Johnny Lawrence’s life has taken a rocky turn as he tries to forget a past that constantly haunts him. But the LaRusso-Lawrence rivalry of yesteryear is reignited when their lives become intertwined with the next generation of “karate kids.”

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.

RAZOR will show that we are already ""living in the future"!

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire
programme.desc: In Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire, the Spengler family returns to where it all started - the iconic New York City firehouse - to team up with the original Ghostbusters, who’ve developed a top-secret research lab to take busting ghosts to the next level. programme.title: CIA (Season 1)

programme.title: Idefix Et Les Irreductibles
programme.desc: 52 before JC. The city of Lutecia is occupied by the Romans... Completely? No! A gang of invincible animals led by Idefix resist the invader again and again and its plans to romanise the city.

programme.title: Les Quiquoi
programme.desc: Olive, Petole, Boulard, Mixo, Raoul and Pamela make up a full-of-fun gang known as the Quiquoi. Together they ask a host of existential questions, using drawings to find the answers. In their own quirky way, they love nothing better than creating surrealist worlds where everything becomes possible.

programme.title: Billy Le Hamster Cowboy
programme.desc: Billy grew up in the Far West. He already has his cowboy outfit and has a burning desire to go on great adventures! With his inseparable friends, Jean-Claude, the earthworm, and Suzie, the little ferret, they're off to face situations as thorny as a cactus.

programme.title: Drazilion
programme.desc: In a world full of mysterious creatures, Oli, Emma, Fabio and Rachel set off on a hunt for Drazilion, the mother creature of Virmark. Their goal: free Captain Goulache from the bad curse put on him, while avoiding the Vikings who are trying to put spokes in their wheel.

programme.title: Tout Le Monde Veut Prendre Sa Place
programme.desc: The game where everyone wants to be a winner. One quiz, six candidates and, comfortably installed in his chair, one champion... whom everyone dreams of unseating!

programme.title: Les Heros Du Patrimoine
programme.desc: After the Second World War, the town had to rebuild. Great architects reinvented public space, giving life, for example, to the Cite radieuse in Marseille. A few decades later, the housing shortage became an issue once again. How can it be connected to the past?

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (1 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: Le Theoreme De Marguerite
programme.desc: Marguerite, a brilliant maths student at the prestigious ecole normale superieure university, is presenting her thesis. But another PhD student interrupts her and refutes her argument. Against everyone's advice, Marguerite gives up her studies. Left to her own devices, with no money, she discovers a passion and a talent for the game of Mahjong.
November 2030. It's 48°C in the classroom. Impossible to do any teaching.

programme.title: Pieges
programme.desc: As the prisoners have a real chance to escape, they are hindered by their physical and mental exhaustion. Time is running out and treason within leads to new catastrophes.

programme.title: Pieges
programme.desc: As freedom finally seems to be within their grasp, everything comes tumbling down for the prisoners. They find themselves facing The Cat's ultimate weapon. Their survival depends on one single person, the weakest, but also the most innocent in the whole plot.

programme.title: Betes De Film
programme.desc: The young wolves are starting to get used to their new environment while it is time for Souro, the old wolf, to move to a space better suited to his needs. It is the end of a chapter and the beginning of a new story at Cine-Zoo.

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.
